title: Ceará Digital Twin for Wildfires: An Open-Source Agentic AI Platform Integrating Near Real-Time Satellite Data and LangGraph Orchestration
highlights: Open-source agentic wildfire platform with LangGraph and three-class alerts
Dry season 2025: 84% precision and 92% recall on 184 days of INPE data
NASA FIRMS pipeline with ReAct agent and RAG on a single EC2 instance
NeKo-PIGNN synthetic R²=0.972; optional GOES-16 for research benchmarks
MIT-licensed deployment integrating FIRMS, INPE, and Open-Meteo
